import pandas as pd

# Data lives in its own data/ subfolder, separate from code -- a habit
# worth keeping as this repo grows. Use forward slashes in the path,
# even on Windows: Python/pandas accept them on every OS, so the same
# code runs unchanged whether you're on Windows, Mac, or Linux. A
# single backslash (data\file.csv) is NOT safe here -- Python reads
# backslashes as escape characters inside a string, which can silently
# produce the wrong path.
df = pd.read_csv("../Project/data/data/Clean Data/mexico_gdp_clean.csv")
n_growth = df["GDP_Growth"].dropna().shape[0]
dict(value=f"{n_growth:,}")

## Row {height=55%}

```{python}
#| title: "Mexico Real GDP and Quarterly Growth"

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

EO_COPPER = "#B87333"
EO_SAGE = "#8A9A5B"
EO_TERRACOTTA = "#E2725B"
EO_CHARCOAL = "#36454F"

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(7, 9))

# Log real GDP
axes[0].plot(
    analysis_data["Date"],
    analysis_data["Log_Real_GDP"],
    color=EO_COPPER,
    linewidth=1.2
)

axes[0].set_title("Mexico’s Log Real GDP — Level")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Log millions of pesos at 2018 prices")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Year")

# Quarterly GDP growth
growth_plot = analysis_data.dropna(
    subset=["GDP_Growth"]
)

axes[1].fill_between(
    growth_plot["Date"],
    growth_plot["GDP_Growth"],
    0,
    where=growth_plot["GDP_Growth"] >= 0,
    color=EO_SAGE,
    alpha=0.7,
    label="Positive"
)

axes[1].fill_between(
    growth_plot["Date"],
    growth_plot["GDP_Growth"],
    0,
    where=growth_plot["GDP_Growth"] < 0,
    color=EO_TERRACOTTA,
    alpha=0.7,
    label="Negative"
)

axes[1].axhline(
    0,
    color=EO_CHARCOAL,
    linewidth=0.6,
    linestyle="--"
)

axes[1].set_title("Mexico’s Real GDP — Quarterly Growth Rate")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Year")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Percent")
axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)

fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Row {height=30%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{python}
#| title: "Stationarity (ADF Test)"
from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import adfuller
from tabulate import tabulate
from IPython.display import Markdown

#| title: "ADF Unit-Root Tests"

from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import adfuller
from tabulate import tabulate
from IPython.display import Markdown

tests = [
    ("Log Real GDP", df["Log_Real_GDP"].dropna(), "ct"),
    ("GDP Growth (%)", df["GDP_Growth"].dropna(), "c"),
]

rows = []
for name, series, regression in tests:
    result = adfuller(series, regression=regression, autolag="AIC")
    conclusion = (
        "Stationary"
        if result[1] < 0.05
        else "Do not reject unit root"
    )
    rows.append([
        name,
        f"{result[0]:.3f}",
        f"{result[1]:.4f}",
        result[2],
        conclusion,
    ])

adf_table = pd.DataFrame(
    rows,
    columns=["Series", "ADF statistic", "p-value", "Lags", "Conclusion"]
)
Markdown(tabulate(adf_table, showindex=False, headers=adf_table.columns))
```

# Model Results

## Row {.tabset height=100%}

### Granger Causality

```{python}
from statsmodels.tsa.api import VAR
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import acorr_ljungbox

model = VAR(df.set_index("date")[variables])
fit = model.fit(2)

rows = []
for cause in variables:
    for effect in variables:
        if cause == effect:
            continue
        test = fit.test_causality(effect, [cause], kind="f")
        verdict = "Causes" if test.pvalue < 0.05 else "No evidence"
        rows.append([cause, effect, f"{test.test_statistic:.2f}", f"{test.pvalue:.4f}", verdict])

granger_table = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["Cause", "Effect", "F-stat", "p-value", "Result"])
Markdown(tabulate(granger_table, showindex=False, headers=granger_table.columns))
```
